*587 Justice BLACKMUN delivered the opinion of the Court.
In this admiralty case we primarily consider whether the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth 
Circuit correctly refused to enforce a forum-selection clause contained in tickets issued by petitioner 
Carnival Cruise Lines, Inc., to respondents Eulala and Russel Shute.
